title: Simply Cozy
description: This mod adds loads of cozy features to minecraft. Crops, Decorations and more!
body:
[![kinetic hosting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e5234712d32562be999b307b425ca6286f4b8e_0.webp)](https://billing.kinetichosting.com/aff.php?aff=1433)

This is a follow up on the grow a crop mod, but now better and cozier! It focuses on adding decoration blocks and crops. This way, I want to make Minecraft cozier to play!

![A Minecraft screenshot showing a rustic wooden building with a large overhang and hanging lanterns, next to a fenced garden patch containing cauliflowers and blue berry bushes on tilled soil, with spruce trees and a blue, cloudy sky in the background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/U52QG9PF/images/809c5b7f39636eb72d82333b0bb56ff51cb54744.png)

The mod adds **crops**:
- Basil, blueberries, cauliflower, chives, cinnamon, coffee, corn, dill, grapes, tea; with more on the way!

![A Minecraft screenshot featuring a small garden patch with various crops, including chives, dill, tea, lettuce, cauliflower, basil, coffee,  corn, and tomatoes, planted in tilled soil right next to a rustic wooden and stone building. Sunlight filters through the trees onto the grassy yard.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ed225da23a412f2b8cec4bed0f8acd66c081bcb_0.webp)

The mod adds **decor** for your:
- Kitchen, living room, lighting, Pride (all wool block/entity variants + beds), garden, clutter (a vase with incense, model ship, etc), holidays (Valentines, Christmas, etc).

![A Minecraft screenshot of a modern, symmetrical indoor music lounge with an open ceiling revealing a starry night sky. In the center is a sunken seating area with armchairs around a glowing fireplace. The back wall features a large arrangement of colourful bookshelves, with an audio mixer, speakers and disc holder placed in front of redstone lamps. The side walls are decorated with paintings between Cozy walls (to absorb sound) and are illuminated by wall lights and tall glowing RGB floor lamps.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e49f75af78d77f659a24732463a5b82d4f2cecb_0.webp)

The mod adds **functional blocks:**
- Audio Mixer (for music playback - WITH CHANNEL SUPPORT) & Speakers 
- Coffee Machine & Coffee Grinder
- Wood Ovens and Toasters
- Fermentation Barrels
- Maple Spile

![Minecraft kitchen interior showing a large stone fireplace with a glowing fire beneath it. On it is a gray cooking pot and a cooking pan. The floor is a classic black-and-white checkered tile pattern and ceiling is made out of wooden planks.. A wooden counter area features an open window looking out to foliage, along with a small stool, wooden shelving and a toaster.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5cedf351cfcbdc5c61e672a35ba9c1c7fc4f6e8_0.webp)

**Recommended mods:**
- [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
- [Simply Fall](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/simply-fall)

**FAQ**
1. Which Minecraft versions are supported? 
Only the latest minecraft version is supported at present, but I plan to backport the mod at some point after the mod reaches release 1.10.
2. May I use this mod in a modpack?
Yes, but please keep in mind to give credit and to not claim or present the mod as your own work.

3. Will the mod ever be added to bedrock?
I am not planning on ever working with bedrock currently, no.

4. May I use the mod in content creation?
Of course!

5. Where can I find the wiki?
In the section 'links' and then click on wiki! (on this page)

**Credits:**

Spartan_B312 - Helps with screenshots and testing the mod, he also made a lot of other models!

HRE_Knight - Helps with streamlining/improving models. Also made countless models besides that!

Smarcle - Made the cottage home painting

Please do note that the mod is still in development and if you experience any bugs please report them in the discord!
